There’s something refreshingly unpretentious about Issaquah’s approach to home and community—people here invest in quality because they genuinely care about where they live, not because they’re performing for a neighborhood they want to impress. That instinct leads to great renovation decisions, and it’s exactly the kind of client we do our best work with. At ARIID Build & Remodel, our home remodeling services start with a genuine understanding of your household—how you cook, how you gather, how you use the spaces that aren’t working, and what your ideal version of the home actually looks and feels like. From there, everything we do—the design, the materials, the construction—is in service of that understanding. Not a generic interpretation of it. The real thing, built properly and built to last.

Why Remodel Your Issaquah Home?

Issaquah attracts people who choose their community with intention and stay long enough to invest in it seriously. A home remodel is one of the most meaningful expressions of that investment—not just financially, but in terms of the daily quality of life that comes from a home that genuinely works for the people inside it. The reasons our Issaquah clients most often describe when they first reach out:

The home has a remarkable setting—trails, mountains, a genuine sense of place—but the interior has never quite lived up to the location, and the gap has become impossible to keep ignoring.
The floor plan was designed for a household that no longer exists: children who have grown, working patterns that have changed, a lifestyle that has evolved far beyond what the original layout was built to support.
They’ve been making incremental updates for years—a new appliance here, a fresh coat of paint there—and they’ve finally decided that what the home actually needs is a comprehensive, properly managed renovation that addresses things at their root rather than their surface.
They want to take full advantage of Issaquah’s consistently appreciating real estate market by investing in quality interior work that the numbers in this area reliably reward.

If you’re still organizing your thinking before reaching out, our guide on what homeowners need to consider before starting a remodel is a practical, no-nonsense starting point that covers the questions worth asking before the first design conversation.

ARIID Build & Remodel: Issaquah Home Remodeling Experts

Issaquah is a community that values authenticity—and that’s exactly what the design-build model delivers over the traditional contractor approach. When design and construction are split between separate entities, the gap between them becomes the place where the original vision gets diluted, timelines stretch, and costs find reasons to grow. As a dedicated design-build firm, ARIID doesn’t have that gap. Our design-build team operates as one integrated unit from the first concept through the final walkthrough—designers and builders who share accountability for the outcome at every stage, not just their respective halves of it. For Issaquah homeowners who want a renovation done with real integrity, that integration is the most important structural choice you can make when selecting a contractor. See what it produces in our completed project gallery.

Our Home Remodeling Services
Full House Remodeling – Comprehensive whole-home transformations that address every room, system, and surface with genuine design intelligence and consistent construction quality throughout—so the finished home feels like a unified whole rather than a series of separate decisions.
Kitchen Remodeling – Issaquah kitchens built around the way Pacific Northwest families actually live—open layouts that connect to the outdoors, natural materials that feel rooted in the setting, and custom finishes that are genuinely yours rather than borrowed from a catalog.
Bathroom Remodeling – From master retreats that bring real luxury and calm to primary suites, to family bathrooms that hold up beautifully through years of daily heavy use—designed with intention and built to last.
Home Additions – Expansions that add genuinely useful living space and integrate with your home’s existing architecture so naturally that the seam between old and new becomes invisible rather than obvious.
Living & Dining Room Renovations – Connected, light-filled spaces that dissolve the compartmentalization of outdated floor plans and replace it with the open, flowing layouts that Issaquah families genuinely prefer to live in.
Primary Suite Renovations – The private retreat your home should have always had—a bedroom, bathroom, and closet designed to make the beginning and end of every day feel genuinely restorative rather than merely adequate.
Basement & Bonus Room Conversions – Thoughtful transformations of the space your home has been sitting on without using—into whatever room type actually serves your household’s specific needs, done with the same quality as every other space in the home.
Interior Design & Finish Selection – Expert material, texture, and finish guidance that creates a coherent design language across your entire home rather than a collection of separate room-by-room choices that never quite add up to something unified.

Whatever scope makes sense for your project, our full-service home remodeling approach ensures every element is properly coordinated and executed to the same standard—from the most visible room in the house to the details most visitors will never notice but that you will feel every single day.

Neighborhoods We Serve in Issaquah

Issaquah has a genuinely wide range of neighborhood characters—from its historic downtown residential streets to the newer communities in the Highlands—and we’re experienced and comfortable working across all of them. Areas we regularly serve include:

Issaquah Highlands – Contemporary homes where renovation brings genuine personalization and design depth to spaces that came with builder-grade choices the setting has always deserved better than.
Central Issaquah – Family-centered renovations that balance beautiful finishes with the practical, durable functionality that households genuinely need from the spaces they use most intensively.
Squak Mountain – Private, wooded properties where renovation design draws deeply on the natural surroundings—organic materials, warm tones, and a connection to the landscape that feels inherent rather than applied.
Talus – Architecturally striking homes in one of Issaquah’s most distinctive developments, where renovation raises the interior standard to match the ambition of the architecture and the natural setting around it.
Olde Town Issaquah – Character-rich historic homes where renovation means adding genuine contemporary comfort and functionality while honoring the architectural personality that makes these properties special in the first place.
Cougar Mountain Area – Spacious, nature-adjacent properties where large windows, natural material choices, and open layouts create kitchens and living spaces that feel genuinely connected to the remarkable landscape beyond the glass.

Learn more about the full range of services we offer in the broader community on our Issaquah remodeling location page.

Current Home Remodeling Trends in Issaquah

Issaquah homeowners tend to make renovation decisions with the same deliberateness they brought to choosing the community—thoughtfully, with a long time horizon, and with a genuine preference for quality that holds up over flash that fades. The home remodeling directions we’re seeing most in Issaquah right now are shaped by the Pacific Northwest environment, the outdoor lifestyle, and a deep appreciation for spaces that feel authentic rather than assembled:

Pacific Northwest-Inspired Material Palettes that bring white oak flooring, natural stone surfaces, and warm organic textures into the home—materials that feel connected to the Cascade landscape Issaquah sits within rather than imported from a showroom in a different climate entirely.
Open-Plan Reconfiguration that removes the walls separating kitchen, dining, and living—creating the connected, family-oriented spaces that Issaquah households genuinely live in rather than the compartmentalized layouts that made sense for a different era of domestic life.
Indoor-Outdoor Living Integration through large sliding or folding glass systems, covered outdoor living areas, and material transitions that extend the home naturally into Issaquah’s remarkable natural setting during the months that allow it.
Primary Suite Expansions that finally give the master bedroom the status it deserves—a spa-level bathroom, a walk-in closet that actually functions as a dressing room, and a private atmosphere that makes genuine rest feel genuinely possible.
Dedicated Home Office Design built properly into the renovation scope from the start—acoustically considered, properly illuminated, and designed for sustained daily work rather than retrofitted from whatever spare room was available.
Sustainable Material Choices that align with the environmental values Issaquah homeowners hold genuinely—locally sourced wood, low-VOC finishes, energy-efficient fixtures—integrated into the design without compromising on beauty or performance.

For more on where home renovation is heading, our 2026 home remodeling tips offer practical, forward-looking perspective—as does our deeper exploration of the most important features of a luxury home remodel.

Home Remodeling Costs in Issaquah

We have the cost conversation early with every Issaquah client—not because it’s the most exciting part of the process, but because it’s one of the most important. Understanding what a renovation will actually cost before you’re emotionally invested in a specific design is just good planning, and there’s no reason it should be treated as an uncomfortable conversation. Home remodeling investment in Issaquah varies considerably depending on what the project involves, how complex the existing home is, and what materials and finishes the design requires. A focused kitchen renovation and a comprehensive whole-home transformation are genuinely different investments at genuinely different scales—and we’ll always be clear about the distinction before you commit to anything. What we never do is quote conservatively to win the project and expand the scope once the work has started. Every estimate is itemized, every line is explained, and every cost discussion happens before decisions get locked in. Our guide on how to choose the best home remodeling contractor for your project covers the specific questions worth asking when you’re comparing proposals and figuring out who to trust.

Why Choose ARIID Build & Remodel?

Issaquah is a community that values doing things properly—and so do we. Our design-build team approaches every Issaquah project with the same commitment: to understand the household genuinely, design for it intelligently, build it with real craft, and stay fully accountable for the outcome from the first conversation to the last detail. We don’t take on projects we’re not equipped to deliver. We don’t disappear after the design phase. We don’t hand your project to a subcontractor team and hope for the best. We stay engaged, we stay accountable, and we finish what we start—to a standard that we’re genuinely proud of and that you’ll be genuinely proud to live in. The things Issaquah clients consistently tell us they valued most after working with ARIID:

We Listened Before We Designed — every project started with us genuinely understanding how they lived, what wasn’t working, and what they actually wanted—before we suggested a single solution or showed them a single option.
The Quality Shows Up Over Time — not just on completion day when everything looks fresh, but months later when the drawers still close perfectly, the surfaces still look beautiful, and the decisions made about materials and construction method reveal themselves as having been the right ones.
One Team Owned the Whole Thing — there was never a moment where something fell between the design side and the build side, because there was no gap between them. One team, one outcome, one place to call with a question.
They Were Treated Like Adults — honest timelines, honest budgets, and honest communication throughout—including when the news wasn’t entirely straightforward.

We’ve also written a clear, practical guide on what the design-build remodeling process actually involves—because we think every Issaquah homeowner deserves to understand exactly what they’re signing up for before they make the decision to start.

Start Your Issaquah Home Remodel Today

Issaquah is a place people choose because they want a certain quality of life—and they’re willing to invest in it. Your home is the most direct expression of that investment. It should be the place where your household genuinely thrives—not the thing on the list you keep meaning to get to.

Book your complimentary consultation today and let’s have a real, honest conversation about what your Issaquah home could be—and exactly what it would take to get there.

Issaquah Highlands and Old Town Issaquah Have Almost Nothing in Common as Home Remodel Markets

Issaquah occupies a geographic position that creates two genuinely different housing markets within the same city. Downtown and central Issaquah — the older parts of the city along Issaquah Creek and the Issaquah-Hobart Road corridor — has pre-1970s construction, original systems, and the kind of character that comes from homes built before mass-production construction methods dominated the Eastside. Issaquah Highlands, developed starting in the 1990s on the plateau above the city, is a master-planned community with HOA oversight, newer construction, and homes that were built to a consistent standard but now show 25 years of age on their finishes and layouts.

Remodeling a home in central Issaquah almost always involves uncovering infrastructure that needs upgrading alongside the cosmetic and layout work. Electrical panels at 100 amps or less are common. Galvanized steel water supply lines with reduced flow are found regularly. In some cases, the original heating system is still in place. ARIID Build conducts a pre-project infrastructure assessment on older Issaquah homes and includes any identified upgrades in the project proposal — so the budget is accurate from the start rather than expanding mid-construction.

Issaquah Highlands remodeling starts from a more modern baseline but has an HOA layer that downtown Issaquah does not. The Issaquah Highlands Community Association requires design review approval for any exterior modification — new windows, additions, deck work, and changes to exterior finish materials. ARIID Build prepares the HOA design review package and submits it in parallel with City of Issaquah permit documents, minimizing the schedule impact of the dual-track approval process.

SEAMLESS FULL HOME TRANSFORMATIONS WITH LASTING LUXURY

At Integral Renovations, we specialize in transforming homes to better suit the evolving needs of our clients. Whether you’re looking to update a kitchen, renovate a master bathroom, or add an extra bedroom for a growing family, our home remodeling services in Buford, GA, can help bring your vision to life. With years of experience, our team of skilled designers, contractors, and project managers ensures that your renovation project is executed flawlessly, from concept to completion.

Our goal is to deliver a stress-free experience for homeowners by handling the entire process, from the initial design phase to the finished product. We believe that every detail matters and never cut corners, ensuring that your home looks stunning and functions perfectly for years to come.

WHY CHOOSE INTEGRAL RENOVATIONS FOR YOUR HOME REMODEL?

When it comes to a home remodel, choosing the right company is crucial. At Integral Renovations, we pride ourselves on delivering high-quality workmanship and exceptional customer service.

Whether you’re renovating a single room or undertaking a complete home makeover, we offer personalized solutions tailored to your specific needs. Here’s why clients trust us with their renovation project:

Customized Designs: No two homes are the same, and neither are our remodeling solutions. We work closely with you to create a design that reflects your personal style and maximizes the potential of your space.
Experienced Contractors: Our team of experienced contractors and craftsmen ensures that every job is completed to the highest standards. From installing new cabinets to reworking walls, we handle even the most complex projects with precision.
Transparent Cost Estimates: We provide clear, detailed estimates so you understand the cost of your remodel from the start. We work within your budget and strive to deliver the best value for your money.
Attention to Detail: We don’t cut corners—every aspect of your remodel is carefully considered, from the materials used to the finishing touches.
THE COMPLETE HOME REMODELING PROCESS

At Integral Renovations, we pride ourselves on offering a seamless renovation process that keeps you informed and engaged at every step. Here’s what you can expect during your home remodel:

01
Initial Consultation

We begin with a thorough consultation to discuss your goals, design preferences, and budget. This is where you can share your vision and any concerns you may have.

02
Design and Planning

Once we understand your needs, our design team will create a customized plan for your remodel. We’ll work with you to select materials, finishes, and layouts that align with your vision for the finished product.

03
Construction and Installation

Our skilled contractors take care of every detail, from demolition to installation. Whether we’re adding new cabinets, upgrading
bathrooms, or creating an extra bedroom, we handle all aspects of the job with precision.

04
Final Walkthrough

Once your remodel is complete, we’ll walk you through the finished product to ensure it meets your expectations. Your satisfaction is our top priority, and we’ll address any concerns to ensure you’re completely happy with your newly renovated home.

OUR COMPREHENSIVE HOME REMODELING SERVICES

We offer a full range of home remodeling services to meet the diverse needs of homeowners. Whether you’re planning a complete home renovation or focused on updating a specific area, we have the expertise to deliver results that exceed your expectations.

Complete Home Renovations

A complete renovation project is ideal for homeowners looking to update their entire space. We start with an in-depth consultation to understand your vision, budget, and goals. Our team handles everything from reconfiguring walls and updating flooring to creating new living spaces like a new room for a growing family or a luxurious master bathroom.

Our complete home renovations
often include:

Custom kitchen remodels with new cabinets and countertops
Spa-like master bathroom makeovers
Living room transformations that create a new look for your space
Additions such as an extra bedroom or expanded living areas
Basement renovations that add valuable square footage

Our focus is on creating cohesive designs that enhance the flow, functionality, and aesthetic of your home.

Kitchen Remodeling

The kitchen is the heart of the home, and a well-executed kitchen renovation can significantly boost both the functionality and value of your property.

Our kitchen remodeling services include layout redesigns, cabinet upgrades, and the installation of high-end countertops and modern appliances. Whether you want a sleek, modern design or a more traditional feel, we can create the perfect kitchen for your lifestyle.

Master Bathroom Renovations

Your master bathroom should be a place of relaxation and luxury. At Integral Renovations, we specialize in creating custom master bathroom remodels that include features like walk-in showers, freestanding tubs, and double vanities.

We’ll work with you to design a space that feels like a personal spa while enhancing your home’s value.

Living Room and Family Room Upgrades

A living room should be a comfortable
space for family gatherings, entertainment, and relaxation.

Whether you’re looking to update the layout or add custom features like built-in shelving, our home remodeling services can transform your living room into a functional and stylish hub for your family. We handle everything from new flooring installations to wall updates that enhance the flow and design of your home.

Bedroom and New Room Additions

If you’re accommodating a growing family
or simply need more space, our extra bedroom and room addition services are the perfect solution.

We’ll help you design and build a new room that integrates seamlessly into your existing home, whether you need a new room for a home office, guest bedroom, or playroom. Our team ensures that every addition is thoughtfully designed and executed.

Basement Remodeling

A finished basement adds valuable living space to your home. Whether you’re looking to create a home theater, gym, or guest suite, our basement remodeling services can help you maximize your space.

We’ll handle everything from insulation and drywall installation to flooring and lighting, ensuring your basement becomes a fully functional part of your home.

TRANSFORM YOUR DREAM BATHROOM INTO REALITY

At Integral Renovations, we believe that every homeowner deserves a dream bathroom that combines luxury, comfort, and functionality. Whether you envision a spa-like retreat or a stylish yet practical space, our bathroom remodeling services in Buford, GA, are designed to help you bring your vision to life. From small upgrades to complete overhauls, we specialize in creating personalized solutions that meet your specific needs.

If you’ve been searching for bathroom remodeling ideas, look no further. Our expert team can transform your existing bathroom into a new bathroom that reflects your style and enhances your home.

WHY CHOOSE INTEGRAL RENOVATIONS FOR YOUR BATHROOM REMODEL?

bathroom remodels:

Custom Designs: We tailor each project to your personal preferences, whether you’re aiming for a master bath with luxurious finishes or a small bathroom remodel that maximizes space.
High-Quality Materials: We only use premium flooring materials, fixtures, and finishes to ensure durability and elegance.
Expert Project Management: Our project managers oversee every aspect of your remodel, keeping everything on track and within budget.
Efficient Turnaround: Depending on the scope, many of our bathroom remodels can be completed in just a few days, allowing you to enjoy your new bathroom without extended disruption.

Once the remodel is complete, we’ll walk you through your new space to ensure everything meets your expectations.

Custom bathroom vanities designed to complement your style

Stylish lighting and fixtures for a complete transformation

Whether you’re looking for clever storage solutions, modern fixtures, or a fresh bathroom layout, we’ll create a design that optimizes your small bathroom and enhances its overall appeal.

Shower and Tub Installation

Your shower or tub is the centerpiece of your bathroom, and upgrading these features can dramatically elevate the space. We offer custom tub installations as well as dream shower designs that cater to your lifestyle.

Whether you prefer a spacious walk-in shower or a luxurious freestanding tub, our team will ensure that your new feature fits seamlessly into your bathroom layout and adds a touch of elegance.

A well-designed vanity can transform the look and functionality of your bathroom. Whether you’re looking for sleek, modern bathroom vanities or more traditional designs, we offer a wide selection of styles and finishes.

We also provide durable countertop options, including quartz, granite, and marble, to complement the overall design of your
new bathroom.

Master Bath Remodeling

If you’re looking to upgrade your master bath, our team is here to help. From custom bathroom vanities to spacious showers and luxurious tubs, we specialize in creating master bathrooms that are both functional and elegant.

We’ll work with you to design a master bath that becomes your personal sanctuary, combining modern amenities with timeless design elements.

DECKS & PATIOS
OUTDOOR LIVING SPACES THAT EXPAND YOUR HOME

Transform your outdoor living space into a beautiful and functional area where you can relax, entertain, and enjoy the natural surroundings. At Integral Renovations, we specialize in creating outdoor living spaces that are designed to meet your specific needs and lifestyle. Whether you’re dreaming of a cozy, private outdoor space for family gatherings or a larger entertainment area for hosting guests, our team is here to bring your vision to life.

With years of experience, we have become a trusted deck and patio company dedicated to delivering high-quality craftsmanship, durable materials, and stunning designs. From custom decks to patios and patio covers, our work enhances the functionality and beauty of your outdoor space while adding value to your home.

WHY CHOOSE INTEGRAL RENOVATIONS FOR YOUR OUTDOOR LIVING SPACE PROJECT ?

As a leading deck and patio company, we understand that creating a beautiful outdoor space requires attention to detail, excellent project management, and the use of the best materials available. At Integral Renovations, our project managers work closely with each client to ensure that every aspect of the design and build process meets their needs. We take pride in providing customized solutions that complement your home’s architecture, reflect your personal style, and create lasting value.

Here’s why clients trust us for their outdoor living space transformations:

Custom Designs:We tailor every project to fit the unique preferences and lifestyle of our clients.
High-Quality Materials: From composite decking to natural wood and durable patio covers, we use only the finest materials to ensure longevity and aesthetic appeal.
Professional Project Management: Our experienced project managers oversee every phase of the project, ensuring that timelines and budgets are respected.
Comprehensive Services: We handle everything from initial design to construction and ongoing maintenance.
OUR OUTDOOR LIVING SPACES SERVICES INCLUDE
Custom Deck Design and Installation

Your deck should be more than just an extension of your home—it should be a functional and aesthetically pleasing outdoor living space where you can enjoy the beauty of your surroundings. As expert deck builders, we create custom decks that are designed to meet your specific needs. Whether you envision a multi-level deck for large gatherings or a small, private deck for personal relaxation, we have the experience and skills to bring your vision to life.

Our deck builder services include everything from concept and design to construction. We work with a variety of materials, including natural wood and composite decking, to create decks that are both durable and visually appealing.

Patio Design and Construction

A well-designed patio can significantly enhance your outdoor space, creating a versatile area for dining, relaxing, or entertaining. Integral Renovations offers custom patio design and construction services that are tailored to fit your home’s architectural style and your personal preferences. We specialize in using high-quality materials such as stone, pavers, and concrete to craft patios that are both functional and visually stunning.

In addition to traditional patios, we also offer the installation of patio covers to protect your outdoor living spaces from the elements. Our patio covers not only provide shade and protection but also add to the overall aesthetic of your outdoor space.

Deck Repair and Maintenance

Over time, decks can show signs of wear and tear, especially if exposed to the elements. If your existing deck is starting to fade, warp, or suffer from other issues, our deck repair and maintenance services can help restore it to its original beauty and functionality.

We provide a range of repair services, from replacing damaged boards to resealing and staining, ensuring that your deck remains a safe and enjoyable space for years to come.

Outdoor Kitchens and Entertainment Spaces

To fully maximize the potential of your outdoor living space, consider adding an outdoor kitchen or entertainment area. We specialize in designing and constructing outdoor kitchens that are perfect for entertaining family and friends.

From built-in grills and countertops to seating areas and outdoor fireplaces, we can transform your outdoor space into a fully equipped entertainment hub.

Patio Covers for Comfort and Style

Installing patio covers is one of the best ways to protect your outdoor areas from harsh weather while enhancing the aesthetic appeal of your home. At Integral Renovations, we offer a wide selection of patio covers that are designed to match the style of your home and provide shade and comfort.

Whether you prefer sleek modern designs
or more traditional styles, we have the expertise to install patio covers that will seamlessly integrate with your patio and make your outdoor living space more functional and inviting.

We had just built a new house, and building our dream outdoor space was the missing piece. They listened to our thoughts, had multiple ideas, and we are very happy where the project landed. Highly recommend!
– John Crowson
Structural Additions
Ready for a major upgrade? We handle it all. From constructing new decks to redesigning your entire patio, we use high-quality materials designed to last. Our team ensures that every structure is built solidly, providing a safe and stylish space for you and your family to enjoy.
Request a Quote
Contact Us
Custom Outdoor Living
Imagine an outdoor space perfectly tailored to your needs, whether it’s for entertaining, relaxation, or a personal retreat. We bring this vision to life by integrating features like outdoor kitchens, fire pits, and ambient lighting, crafted to enhance your outdoor experience.
Request a Quote
Contact Us
Detail-Oriented Design
Details make the difference in our outdoor projects. From the strategic placement of lighting to maximize ambiance and functionality, to the selection of furniture that matches your style and withstands the elements, we are dedicated to creating spaces that are as practical as they are stunning. Every element is chosen to complement your lifestyle and elevate the beauty of your home.
Request a Quote
Contact Us
MATERIALS WE USE FOR OUTDOOR LIVING SPACES

At Integral Renovations, we are committed to using only the highest quality materials for our projects. This ensures that your outdoor space not only looks beautiful but also lasts for years to come. We offer a variety of materials for decks and patios, including:

Natural wood

Known for its timeless beauty and natural warmth, natural wood is a popular choice for homeowners looking for a classic look. We use durable woods such as cedar and redwood, which are resistant to rot and insect damage.

Composite decking

For homeowners looking for a low-maintenance option, composite decking offers the look of wood without the upkeep. This material is resistant to fading, scratching, and staining, making it an excellent choice for busy households.

Stone and pavers

For patios, we use a range of stone and pavers to create custom designs that complement your home’s exterior and landscaping.

WHY INVEST IN A OUTDOOR LIVING SPACE?

A professionally designed and built deck or patio can transform your outdoor living space, providing an area for relaxation, entertainment, and family gatherings. Beyond enhancing your lifestyle, a well-constructed deck or patio can also increase the value of your home.

Investing in high-quality decking or patio services ensures that you are creating a beautiful outdoor space that will stand the test of time. At Integral Renovations, we believe that your outdoor area should be just as functional and stylish as the interior of your home, which is why we strive to design outdoor living spaces that meet your needs and exceed your expectations.

Comprehensive Kitchen Remodeling Services

Custom Cabinetry and Cabinet Refacing: Your kitchen cabinets play a significant role in the overall aesthetic and functionality of your space. We design and install custom cabinetry to optimize storage space, or we can give your existing current cabinets a fresh look through expert cabinet refacing.
Countertop Replacement: Upgrade your kitchen countertops with materials like quartz, granite, marble, or butcher block to create a durable and visually stunning workspace.
Backsplash Installation: Add color, texture, and protection to your walls with our wide selection of backsplash tiles, installed with precision and care.
Lighting and Flooring: Proper lighting is essential in any kitchen remodel. From stylish light fixtures to durable flooring options like tile, hardwood, or laminate, we ensure your kitchen is both beautiful and practical.
Appliance Integration: Seamlessly incorporate modern appliances into your kitchen design for a cohesive and functional space.
Experienced Designers and Craftsmen

BASEMENT REMODELING
HIDDEN SPACES REIMAGINED FOR LIVING WORK OR PLAY

Your basement holds untapped potential to become a beautiful and functional space that adds value to your home and enhances your lifestyle. At Integral Renovations, our basement remodeling services are designed to transform unfinished basements into cozy family rooms, game rooms, or luxurious entertainment areas. Whether you’re looking for extra space for your growing family or a custom-designed home theater, we provide the expertise to make your dream basement a reality.

WHY CHOOSE INTEGRAL RENOVATIONS FOR YOUR BASEMENT REMODELING?
A Professional Team with Expertise in Basement Renovations

Our construction team consists of experienced basement remodeling contractors dedicated to delivering quality results. From design to execution, we manage the entire process with precision and care. Whether it’s installing basement flooring, adding recessed lighting, or creating custom storage solutions, our professional team ensures every detail is addressed.

Customized Solutions for Every Homeowner

We understand that every homeowner has unique needs and preferences. That’s why we offer tailored solutions to fit your lifestyle and budget. Whether you want to completely transform an unfinished basement into a livable space or enhance an existing family room, our goal is to deliver a space that’s functional and aesthetically pleasing.

COMPREHENSIVE BASEMENT REMODELING SERVICES
Basement Finishing and Flooring Options

A key component of any basement remodel is selecting the right flooring. We offer a variety of options, including:

Hardwood flooring for a classic and elegant look.
Carpet for a warm and inviting feel.
Luxury vinyl tile for durability and moisture resistance.

Our team ensures that all flooring is installed properly to withstand the unique challenges of basement environments.

Wall Treatments and Insulation

Adding basement walls with proper insulation helps maintain a comfortable temperature year-round. We also provide moisture-resistant wall finishes to protect against
air leaks and enhance the durability of
your space.

Lighting and Natural Light Solutions

Lighting is essential for creating a welcoming atmosphere in your new basement. We specialize in installing recessed lighting, which provides even illumination and a modern look.

For basements with limited light, we can add egress windows to bring in natural light and comply with safety regulations.

Custom Features for Your Dream Basement

Make your basement truly unique with our custom features:

Wet bars for entertaining guests.
Home theaters for movie nights with the whole family.
Game rooms for recreational fun.
Custom shelving and built-in storage to maximize square footage.
Expanding Your Living Space

Transform your basement into a space that serves the entire family. Whether it’s an extra bedroom, an office, or a playroom, our designs maximize extra space while maintaining a cohesive look with the rest of your home.

THE REMODELING PROCESS: FROM CONSULTATION TO COMPLETION
01
Free Home Consultation

We begin every remodeling project with a comprehensive in-home consultation. This allows our project managers to understand your vision, assess your space, and provide an accurate estimate.

02
Design and Planning

Our whole team works with you to design a basement that fits your needs and preferences. Whether you’re looking for a modern design with drop ceilings or a rustic look with natural wood accents, we bring your ideas to life.

03
Construction and Installation

Our basement remodeling contractors handle all aspects of construction, including plumbing, electrical work, and bathrooms.
We ensure that every feature is built to last, from flooring to
custom shelving.

04
Final Touches for a Polished Look

The finishing touches, such as paint, trim, and lighting, are what truly make your basement shine. Our attention to detail ensures your new space is both functional and beautiful.

Our goal is to craft a space that is as practical as it is beautiful, ensuring every design element is both stylish and durable.

THE BENEFITS OF BASEMENT REMODELING
Add Value to Your Home

A professionally remodeled basement significantly increases your home’s value. By turning an unfinished basement into a functional area, you expand your living space and make your property more appealing to potential buyers.

Enjoy a Functional Basement for Everyday Use

An upgraded basement provides more than just additional rooms; it creates opportunities for relaxation, entertaining, and family bonding. Imagine hosting game nights in a cozy family room or watching movies in your personal theater.

Improve Energy Efficiency

With proper insulation and sealing, your remodeled basement becomes more energy-efficient, reducing costs associated with heating and cooling.

WHY INTEGRAL RENOVATIONS IS THE RIGHT CHOICE

At Integral Renovations, we are more than just a finishing company—we are your partners in transforming your basement into a functional and beautiful space that adds value to your home. We take pride in creating tailored solutions that meet the unique needs of every homeowner while maintaining the highest standards of craftsmanship and quality.

Our team is committed to ensuring a stress-free experience by providing clear communication, detailed planning, and expert execution throughout the entire process. From the initial consultation to the final walkthrough, our goal is to not only meet but exceed your expectations, delivering results that reflect your vision and enhance your lifestyle. With Integral Renovations, you can trust that your project is in capable and caring hands.

Carpentry and Repairs

Replacing Doors and Windows

Worn-out doors and windows not only affect your home’s appearance but also its energy efficiency. We specialize in replacing doors and windows, ensuring they fit perfectly and enhance the overall look and function of your space.

Ceiling Fans and Light Fixtures

Installing or repairing ceiling fans and light fixtures is one of the most common handyman tasks we handle. A well-functioning fan or properly installed light fixture can make a significant difference in any room’s comfort and ambiance.

Flooring and Furniture Assembly

Whether you’re installing new flooring or need help assembling furniture, our handyman team is here to assist. We’ll ensure every piece is securely and correctly
put together, saving you time
and frustration.

Creating a safe environment for your little ones is essential. Our baby-proofing services include installing cabinet locks, securing furniture, and making other adjustments to ensure your home is child-friendly.

General Maintenance and Repairs

Have a long to-do list? Let us help you tackle it. From fixing leaky faucets to patching drywall, our general maintenance services cover all the little tasks that can pile up over time.

Hanging Pictures and Mirrors

Adding personal touches to your space is important, and our team can help you hang pictures, mirrors, or other wall decorations securely and at the perfect height.

Save Time and Effort

High-Quality Results

Our service professionals are trained and experienced, ensuring every task is completed to the highest standard. Whether it’s fixing a window or installing a new door, you can trust us to deliver results
that last.

Cost-Effective Solutions

Investing in professional handyman services can save you money in the long run. By addressing small repairs early, you can prevent larger, more costly problems from developing.

Reliable Team

Our team is skilled and also dependable. We show up on time, ready to complete the job with minimal disruption to your day.

Versatility

From carpentry to cleaning, our handyman tasks cover a wide range of services. This versatility makes us a one-stop solution for all your repair and maintenance needs.

HOW TO SCHEDULE AN APPOINTMENT

Booking an appointment with Integral Renovations is easy. Our friendly office staff will assist you in selecting a convenient time and provide an estimate for the services you need. We’ll connect you with our team of professionals who will arrive prepared to tackle your to-do list in Buford, GA.

Integral Renovations is proud to serve our neighbors and community in Buford, GA. Our commitment to quality and customer satisfaction has made us a trusted name in the industry.

We are committed to excellence and innovation, ensuring our clients receive top-tier services that elevate their projects.

Here’s what sets us apart:

Immersive Visualizations: Experience your project from every angle with realistic 3D walk-throughs.
Detailed Customization: Adjust layouts, colors, finishes, and more in real-time to align with your dream design.
Reduced Surprises: Avoid unexpected outcomes and make informed decisions with the help of our predictive technology.
Unmatched Expertise: Our skilled team combines technical knowledge with creative vision to deliver exceptional results.
REVAMP, RELAX, REPEAT

3D rendering allows you to experience your project before construction even begins. Imagine walking through your newly designed space, visualizing layouts, finishes, and details in real time. This service doesn’t just provide insights; it brings confidence and clarity to the renovation process.

Our approach is tailored to reduce surprises, enhance
communication, and provide clients with assurance as they embark
on their renovation journey.

3D RENDERING FOR STUNNING RESULTS

Our team utilizes a state-of-the-art platform to create highly detailed and interactive renderings. This advanced technology allows us to:

Create lifelike environments tailored to your specific project needs.
Enhance communication between clients, architects, and contractors.
Deliver precise and innovative solutions for both residential and commercial projects.
THE 3D RENDERING PROCESS
01
Initial Consultation

Your journey begins with a consultation where we discuss your project goals, budget, and timeline. Whether you are seeking a simple design refinement or an expansive architectural overhaul, we’ll work closely with you to understand your vision and specific needs, ensuring the final rendering aligns perfectly with your expectations.

02
Concept Development

Using your ideas and input, we create a detailed concept that includes architectural layouts, finishes, and design elements.

Our process focuses on developing a
clear connection between your vision and the final product. This stage also incorporates tailored solutions for unique challenges or complex requirements.

03
Creating the Rendering

Our team leverages tools to produce an interactive and immersive 3D rendering. This rendering showcases the complexity, timeline, and progression of your project, allowing you to visualize every detail with precision. Real-time adjustments ensure your vision is accurately represented.

04
Review and Adjustments

We present the rendering to you for review, making adjustments based on your feedback. This collaborative process ensures that every element of your project meets your standards and expectations. By fostering open communication, we ensure your satisfaction at every stage.

05
Delivering the Final Visualization

Once finalized, we deliver the completed rendering, providing a comprehensive preview that will guide the construction process and elevate your renovation experience. Our detailed documentation and visual aids ensure smooth execution and alignment with your original vision.

3D renderings make the renovation process easier and more exciting. See your ideas come to life, make changes confidently, and ensure every detail aligns with your dream space.

3D RENDERING SERVICES
Enhancing Communication

3D renderings improve collaboration by providing a clear and realistic representation of your project. This fosters better communication between clients, contractors, and designers, bridging the gap between ideas and execution.

Our services are fully customizable, ensuring your design reflects your personal style and specific needs. Adjustments can be made effortlessly during the process, bringing your ideas to life without compromise.

Streamlining the Process

By identifying potential issues early, our 3D renderings save time and money. This streamlined approach ensures a smooth renovation journey from start to finish, minimizing unexpected delays and costs.

Elevating Sales and Marketing

For commercial clients, 3D renderings can be
a powerful sales tool.

Visualize and present your ideas to stakeholders, creating a strong connection with your audience and enhancing your sales strategy with precise and engaging visuals.

Precision and Detail

Our renderings incorporate every detail, from architectural intricacies to subtle design elements. This attention to detail ensures that the final construction aligns perfectly with the client’s vision and expectations.

PROUDLY SERVING BUFORD, GA, AND BEYOND

Located at 2693 Braselton HWY, Buford, GA, Integral Renovations is proud to serve clients across Georgia, including Atlanta and surrounding areas. Our focus on quality and innovation ensures that every project is executed to the highest standards.

Whether you’re enhancing a single room or undertaking an entire home renovation, our 3D rendering services will elevate your project to new heights.

MEET THE FOUNDER
Taylor Scalera
BUSINESS OWNER
Taylor’s journey began with a passion for soccer and summers spent learning the intricacies of residential construction. After a brief post-college corporate stint, he returned to construction, starting as a project estimator for a small handyman business and quickly rising to Vice President. He significantly contributed to the company’s expansion to a national presence. After six years, Taylor channeled his expertise into founding Integral Renovations, committed to delivering exceptional, fairly-priced home renovation services. Leading a team of top-tier professionals, he ensures every project prioritizes quality, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.
Having spent my entire career in the industry, my goal is to take my knowledge and network and give homeowners a quality & hassle free experience with extremely fair pricing. Our team is built of A+ players, and we take pride in customer satisfaction.

At Integral Renovations, our dedicated team is at the heart of everything we do. Comprising seasoned professionals from diverse backgrounds in design, construction, and project management, each team member brings a unique set of skills and a shared commitment to excellence. Our collaborative approach ensures that every project benefits from comprehensive expertise and a deep understanding of each client’s vision.
 
The Integral Renovations difference lies in our meticulous attention to detail and our commitment to using only the highest quality materials. We believe that the foundation of a successful renovation is not just in meeting expectations but in exceeding them. Our team goes above and beyond to ensure that every aspect of our work—from initial designs to the final touches—is executed with precision and care.
 
We take pride in our ability to transform homes into spaces that reflect the individuality and lifestyle of their owners. This personalized approach has not only earned us the trust and loyalty of our clients but has also set us apart in the industry. At Integral Renovations, we don’t just build and renovate homes—we craft environments that enhance and inspire the lives of those who inhabit them.

The Kitchen Concepts NW Team

Kitchen Concepts was founded by David Warren (pictured far right) in 1989. Dave is a licensed and bonded general contractor.

When you entrust your project to us you have the assurance of knowing that the contractor responsible for your job is the owner of the company, not a outsider with no permanent relationship to the business.

The Kitchen Concepts team has a combined total of 59 years in Kitchen design. The people that install your kitchen are the same ones that designed it. We have practical experience in the business and know what works and what does not.

Kitchen Concepts has a showroom with many different types of cabinets and kitchens on display at 400 NE Division Gresham OR, 97030. When you come into the Showroom Roxane, John or Matt would love to tell you about our cabinets and what we can do for you, they truly love working with people and will make your visit very pleasant. You get personal service at Kitchen Concepts. We also have a second showroom at 12518 NE Airport way. Call Mandy, Rod or Dave there at 503-445-6350 if you have any questions.

The Kitchen Concepts Installers work directly for Kitchen Concepts, this gives you the comfort of knowing that the people installing your cabinets have the same commitment to Quality as the rest of the Team. We have installed literally hundreds of kitchen in the Portland metropolitan area for very happy customers.

Like any general contractor Kitchen Concepts uses subcontractors for specialty services. These skilled craftsman have worked with Kitchen Concepts for many years and have the same commitment to customer service as the rest of the Kitchen Concepts team.

The work done was exceptional, 4 years later and we still have zero complaints, everything is still as beautiful as day one. Highly recommend Kitchen concepts to create you your dream kitchen.”

“Excellent! very easy to work with, good high quality options, installation, timeliness, etc. first remodel in a long time for us, and the cabinets are so much nicer! would definitely use them again.”

“The cabinets and countertops are beautiful and match sample materials perfectly. Dave Warren and whole team were great. Dave did a great job helping me with the cabinet design, making sure measurements were accurate, and creatively dealing with some existing kitchen layout challenges. I highly recommend him and Kitchen Concepts!”

“It went excellent, kitchen concepts are highly recommended and have years of experience. They have an excellent team of designers and installers! I would use them on every remodel or new construction.”

From the first phone call to the end of the project, Matthew listened to our wishes, expertly guided the process, and followed up to make sure our project was done to perfection. He recommended a contractor (Ryan Ferguson of R.E.C. Construction); they coordinated and gave us a beautiful, functional new kitchen on time, on budget, and we couldn’t be happier. Call Matthew. You won’t be sorry, I promise!”

“From our first conversation, I knew Dave was a good person. I learned over the months we worked with him is that he is also professional, creative, patient (SO PATIENT!), honest, trustworthy, resourceful, and exceptional. Really. He has taken fantastic care of us and I have no doubt he does the same for all his clients. Hire him.”

“Dave and his team were absolutely fantastic. We got our dream layout with a challenging 1922 craftsman. Dave also had great recommendations for contractors. I would work with him again anytime.”
Before And After Galleries

Free Consultations!

” … I just wanted to thank you and Dave for being so patient with answering my questions. I am sincerely overwhelmed with your service, both of you are amazing and we are glad we chose your company to do the work for us..”

” I wanted to send you a quick note to thank you for your exceptional customer service. Although there were a few hiccups, you ensured everything was done, and done right. It’s rare these days to find a business that is customer-centric, and I truly appreciate your commitment to your customers. Thanks again.”

Thank you from the bottom of my heart, Kitchen Concepts for being the incredible business that you are. You make a difference.”

” The burnished, distressed finish is perfect! The crew that came yesterday was fantastic! Today’s as well. On time, careful. So far I’m very impressed with your people! Thank you much!”

Lois R.

“Thanks for all your hard work in my kitchen. I’m really enjoying it! We appreciated Jason’s careful work installing the cabinets. Great job. Miguel did well as well. Thanks again!”

Rene & Nathan B.

“The kitchen is beautiful! Please know that Michael did an excellent job and we appreciate his work and attention to detail. If you need a reference, we would be happy to speak to people about the product and service!”

Ron S.

” The cabinet and countertop look amazing. Thanks for all your help and guidance. We appreciate it so much ..”

Rene & Nathan B.

“Kitchen Concepts Crew, Thanks so much for giving us a Beautiful Kitchen. You were so very helpful in bringing all of our wishes into one lovely and modern area. Everything came together just as we pictured it. It’s like a brand new home.”

Jan and Dave

” Wow!……..we are blown away with how fantasic our kitchen looks. We love everything about the cabinets – they are way more gorgeous than I imagined!”

July 2025

When you decide to take on a remodel project it is difficult to know where to start and most importantly can you trust the contractor? Deanna and I had wanted to remodel our kitchen for many years, but it seemed who ever we called either gave us a quote that was well outside our budget or drew up designs that didn’t even align with what we discussed. This is where Rod from Kitchen Concepts NW comes in.

From the beginning, Rod seemed to know exactly what we wanted. His attention to practical details and functional features were exactly what we wanted. Immediately keying in on the troubled layout we had and knowing exactly what would give Deanna and I the Kitchen we dreamed of.

1. Estimate – Rod drew up plans and helped us make good decisions and then provided a quote that was spot on. Gave us ranges where we needed to be aware of potential increases and was flexible to allow us to do some of the work to save cost.

2. Timing and schedule – everyone has had horror stories of the never ending project. Rod set out the schedule and we finished within 2 day(early) of the original end date. Communication was great and no surprises. This only comes from many years of experience and expertise.

3. Quality and detail – Rod and John are incredible. Every detail was precise and things we didn’t even think of, were accounted for. Noticing even the slightest blemish on a door was address before either Deanna or myself noticed.

I would absolutely recommend Kitchen Concepts. The pictures dont truly capture just how amazing this transformation was.

Thank you Rod and John for making this our favorite place to be in the house.

Jeff Greenburg

April 2025

Excellent! Good recommendations, attention to little details, work performed on
schedule. The absolute best, professional 3-man crew – anybody would enjoy having them
doing remodel work in your house while you were in the home.

Vernon Danell

Hi Dave,

Kitchen is done and we love it. Thank you to everyone involved!. Great job all around!

Dan Tupper

Hi Dave,

Thanks for all your work and guidance on our project. You were an exceptional part of the entire experience and I learned a lot from how you approach your clients and your craft.

All the best,
Neil Pohl

March 2024

Please pass on from me and my wife Juliana, our sincere appreciation to Rod and all the folks who helped put our new kitchen in place.  It is beautiful and I don’t know that we could be happier with the result.  Also, your referral to Damon Douglas was spot on.  He and his team were a pleasure to work with. – Jeff T.

February 2024

” I love my new kitchen and want to thank you for leading me down this path.  I appreciated your expertise!  I also want to thank you for recommending Douglas Carpentry & Construction.   They were the best to work with!”  – Patty S.

November 2023

Dave,

I cannot thank you and your team enough for the amazing effort you put into helping me have the kitchen I dreamed of but started to think would never happen. I purchased my home during COVID and interviewed three contractors over three years and actually paid two of them for design work. I never felt comfortable enough moving forward with any of them. One day I walked into your showroom and heard you working with a client on the phone. Your manner, expertise and recommendations made me feel 100% comfortable with you and I moved forward immediately. You were patient, kind and willing to discuss different options and made the process so easy for me. You helped me to move forward through my points of indecision, without pushing me but by simply guiding me. Had I not found you I don’t think my kitchen would be remodeled even today, 5 years later. Your recommended installer and countertop vendor were also incredibly professional and competent. The finished kitchen is absolutely beautiful. I so wanted the Dark Walnut and you helped me with a door style that made it affordable for me. The cabinets are gorgeous and I get so many compliments during the many dinner parties I have hosted since the completion. Thank you so very much. I really appreciate you!!

– S. Mueller

” Dave, You continue to amaze!

The level of support and service you provide your customers is, in my experience, without parallel. We cannot thank you enough. You can be sure that if we have a chance to promote your business we will be more than happy to do so.

More photos of this kitchen here.

So you know, John came by Monday, fixed the drop-down tray,made some minor adjustments to a couple of cabinet doors and replaced a couple of door bumpers that had gone missing. As always, his work was delivered in a professional and friendly way.

Here we are three years after the kitchen renovation was completed, continuing to thoroughly enjoy the kitchen design, the cabinetry that you carefully helped us select and the work of the contractor you recommended, O’Connell Dixon. Quite literally, the new kitchen has transformed the look of the interior of our home, how we live in it and how we entertain. We could not be more pleased with the outcome we obtained through you and your company.

Regards, Larry and Elizabeth K.

“Couldn’t stand it. I had to peek. Got to look at the front of an island cabinet and I unwrapped one of the turned corner pieces. The burnished, distressed finish is perfect! The crew that came yesterday was fantastic! Today’s as well. On time, careful. So far I’m very impressed with your people! Thank you much!” – Marci

Select here for more photos.

” My wife and I had been planning and hoping for a kitchen remodel for the entire 34 years we have lived in our home, and now it was finally time to get it done.  We were quite excited.  In the interest of clarity here, we wanted a complete replacement of our old existing cabinets with something beautiful that would not be outdated in 10 years, we wanted new quartz counter tops, a new sink and fixtures, a new dishwasher and stove hood and a new island in the middle of the kitchen with custom cutting boards and bookshelves for cookbooks, etc.  .  We did not replace the refrigerator or stove, and our existing tile floor is only 4 years old so we worked our color selections around that.  We visited both the Gresham and Airport Way locations during our remodel selections.

After contacting over a half dozen kitchen re-modelers, and actually interviewing 3 of them, we settled on Kitchen Concepts. The first words out of the mouths of the other two candidates were warnings that it might be difficult to complete the job on our budget, the insinuation being that to get what we had in mind would require much more money than what we had to work with. This was especially distressing as we hadn’t even gone into detailed discussions with them about what we hoped to have done.   Dave Warren, the owner of Kitchen Concepts, came out to our place a few days later to actually measure and discuss our plans.  We immediately felt comfortable.  Dave was not only very knowledgeable, enthusiastic and experienced, but he contributed many imaginative ideas and options to our original plan that we hadn’t previously thought about or considered.   Rather than trying to up sell us, he also assured us that barring any sort of major surprise or problem behind our walls, etc, (which we understood) we would be able to get what we wanted, plus his suggestions, and within our budget.

This kind of job required a Kitchen Concepts partnership with a solid and reliable contractor, and Dave has partnered with Division 6 Contracting.  Matt from Division 6 coordinated the subcontractors to include not only his own crew (thanks to Mark, Adam and Kevin!)  for demolition, install,  woodwork, backsplash, etc, but also the electrician, plumber, dry wall and painting.  Every single subcontractor showed up on time, did top drawer work and cleaned up properly after themselves.  Adam and Kevin especially worked the extra mile to professionally accommodate any of our “special” requests and questions and Mark’s complete attention to our last minute “checklist” earned him a spot at the dinner table for homemade goulash.

No job of this size and scope is without its “hiccups” and we had a few but the question is not whether you might run into an issue during a remodel that uses so many workers, but how the problem(s) are handled when they arise.  Without a doubt these things were handled quickly, professionally and in a cheerful manner by everyone involved, no questions asked.    In the end, we came in VERY close to our budget, the job was done a few days earlier than we’d expected, and our cabinets, countertops, walls and backsplash are beyond stunning.
Two thumbs up to Dave Warren, Matt, Mark and crew.  We are so pleased and thrilled with our new kitchen and we know we will be for years to come.”

We just wanted to Thank You so much for your kind service. I came to your store to get replacement hinges for my pantry doors that the former owners of our home had put in in 1990. Everyone was so kind to me. I then went back a few days later and got hardware for one of my drawers. If we were remodeling the kitchen we know who we will or would call. You all went above and beyond Great service over 10 years after an install. Thanks! — The Lockharts

“Kitchen Concepts, Thanks for all your hard work in my kitchen. I’m really enjoying it! We appreciated Jason’s careful work installing the cabinets. Great job. Miguel did well as well. Thanks again” — Lois R.

“Wow!……..we are blown away with how fantasic our kitchen looks. We love everything about the cabinets – they are way more gorgeous than I imagined! And………… Mark did an amazing and careful job installing, and his work putting up the molding is a thing of beauty. He is a real craftsman (although he insists it is because of the tools he uses). He was very careful about leaving everything cleaned up – including the driveway where he had his saw. What a guy!! Dave, thank you for your guidance and patience !! I won’t hesitate to recommend Kitchen Concepts.” — Jan and Dave

“Dear Dave & Sharon, The kitchen is beautiful! Please know that Michael did an excellent job and we appreciate his work and attention to detail. If you need a reference, we would be happy to speak to people about the product and service!! Thank you for your assistance!!”
— Rene & Nathan B.

“Jon did an outstanding job of trimming out the shoe and the light rail. It is probably the most professional job I have ever seen. Pass this compliment on to him since I wasn’t home when he finished.” — Bill T.

“…. November 2004 my kitchen was completed and I still stand back to admire it’s appearance and functionality. I have never been so pleased over a completed project as the kitchen. Thank you so much for your input and occasionally reluctant suggestions that I found very important. Thank you once again. — Fran S.

” Dave, The cabinets look great, they all have a healthy top coat on them. I am truly delighted to finally have the kitchen of my dreams. Thank you so very much for standing behind your service and the products you sell, especially when the manufacturer did not. I will gladly recommend your company and staff to anyone who is looking to remodel their kitchen.” — The Carey Family

” Dear Kitchen Concepts, (Dave, Sharon, Don and Jason) Just a short note to thank-you for the wonderful job you did on our kitchen remodel. From the very beginning of our remodel, everyone involved in the KC team had been very helpful. From the beautiful layout that Dave designed to the quick and thorough installation that Don and Jason accomplished. Sharon was always available for any questions that we had along the way and always had a smile in her voice. We can’t believe how much our kitchen has changed. Ian and I can actually work in the kitchen together and not bump into each other. I stand in the middle of our new kitchen and look around in awe. It has transformed from a small, unworkable space, into a spacious, chef’s paradise. I’ve enclosed a few pictures for your “album”, and hope that is constitutes a ‘gold star’ in your repertoire. Kitchen Concepts was very professional, organized, and very helpful in making our dream come true. We can’t thank-you enough for everything that your “Kitchen Concepts family” did for us. We owe you a debt of gratitude and believe me when I say that I think of you every day that I step into our new kitchen.Please enjoy the savory cheesecakes that I’ve prepared for you. It can’t come close to the thanks that we have. Thanks again for the wonderful job!” — Sheila and Ian Kyles

“Dear Friends: We want to thank you for all the magnificent kitchen cabinets and countertops that you installed in our home. Not only are we pleased with the workmanship, we were pleased with the entire installation process. From our first meeting at the home show, through the style, color selection and cabinet configuration, each of you contributed your collective years of experience to our understanding of cabinets and how they could be fashioned to meet our needs, desires and budget. The way you presented features and guided us through the benefits of each without pressure allows us today to enjoy our highly functional and esthetically pleasing new kitchen. We can not end this letter without mentioning your installer, Mike who made it all happen. When a workman unloads his well organized truck, sets up his equipment in precise fashion and has well seasoned special jigs and equipment for various phases of the work, you know you have a professional with lots of experience about to perform “magic” also shows in our kitchen. Though our kitchen is small (9 by 12 feet), we felt we received the full attention of everyone involved just as if it were 30 by 30 feet. Please add us to your list of satisfied customers.Thank you all and let us know when the French chef will be arriving to prepare our meals for the next year-that was part of the contract, wasn’t it? ” Sincerely, – Fred and Diane Born

“Wow!……..we are blown away with how fantastic our kitchen looks. We love everything about the cabinets – they are way more gorgeous than I imagined! I won’t hesitate to recommend Kitchen Concepts.” — Jan and Dave

” Dave, I’m writing this to personally thank you for the excellent kitchen remodel recently completed in our home. Serendipity brought us to Kitchen Concepts, located within DeWitt Appliance. We happened upon your display as we shopped for a stove and were immediately impressed with your knowledge and enthusiasm. Let me say that this new kitchen is a design that works. We spent ten years in a nonfunctional space that looked good to visitors but was a misery to Tom and me, as we struggled to navigate around the awkward layout. Your design has created a space we enjoy and want to use. While it was you who planned the design, it was Ed who put the monster together. I was amazed by his attention to detail. For anyone out there planning a cabinet installation, know this: when you work with Dave, you also get Ed, and you want Ed to install your cabinets. Trust me. We can’t thank you enough for a smooth, seamless process that was made as painless as possible by your excellent service.” With gratitude, — Andrea and Tom Louisell

” THANK YOU!!!!!!!!!!!!!! We had a dream of remodeling our kitchen, family room, dining room, and powder room, to make our home more livable and convenient. That dream came true because of the very capable team of skilled, dedicated, and professional tradesmen working on our home, and the perfect cabinets with their many useable features. Dave, you are a real professional, very helpful, and a pleasure to work with. We are so pleased the way you patiently guided us through the process. Your computer design program is a real plus to confused homeowners. We wish you much continued health, happiness and success. All the best! ” — Todd and Carol

” Dave, Don, Sharon, Jason & Wendy, I love my new kitchen!! You guys were great to work with. Jason and Wendy did an excellent job installing and Sharon helped me a lot in picking the countertops. Also, Dave thanks for help in designing and Don you started it all. Merry Christmas!” — Rob

“Thank you to all! Our kitchen is beautiful! The quality is top notch. Joe is the best, we have had a lot of work done in our home, never, have we seen such neatness and perfection as the work that Joe has done. We have a little bit of trim work around the window, and you can come and see and take pictures if you would like. We just used the G.C to Newport Bay. Thank you! “— John & Lyna D.

“Kitchen Concepts Crew, Thanks so much for giving us a Beautiful Kitchen. You were so very helpful in bringing all of our wishes into one lovely and modern area. Everything came together just as we pictured it. It’s like a brand new home.” — Tom & Barb S.

“Hi Dave, I wanted to Thank You again for all your help in assisting us with our bathroom cabinet selection. The time you spent with my sister and me was so helpful! I love that computer program of yours! Can’t wait to see them in and the bathroom done. Hopefully, O’Connel has returned the wood samples you gave me he said he would.” Thanks again, Ollie

“Dear Rod, The countertops were completed yesterday. I want to thank you and your subcontractors for the excellent work. The kitchen was built well out of line, square and plumb. The team did an excellent job fitting the counters and making everything look right. Also, I have installed most of the cabinet doors, and every one has fit as planned. The workmanship for everything is excellent I have also received the one cabinet door that was missing from the order. Thank you again for putting this together and managing it. In the future, I will be happy to recommend Kitchen Concepts to anyone. I will also put in a good word with Angie’s list. I received your invoice, and I believe my second check for $2,000.00 crossed it in the mail. By now, you should have that check. If not, please let me know. Iam enclosing my final payment of $2,464.00 for the countertops. ” Best regards,— Marcus Lester

“The Cori0n is beautiful! The installers did a perfect job! Thanks! P.S. Worth every penny. “— Another happy Customer

“We want to thank you, for helping us to achieve success in our kitchen remodel. We appreciate your advice and expertise, and your assistance in the planning phase, and in following it through to finish in a timely way. Thank you, Sharon, for keeping everybody on schedule! The contractors you recommended did an excellent job as well = we enjoyed getting to know Jason, Chris, and Isaac. Watching them work together was fun and enlightening – there is so much to installation we hadn’t thought of! They were extremely careful with measurements and leveling. It looks really good, and everything works! Thanks also to Jon, who delivered cabinets, and came back to replace the hinges. We still have boxes to empty and put away, but that’s OK – we made it in time to have our family here on Christmas Day, and they all love what we had done. We are happy to recommend your business to anyone who is looking for quality workmanship! Thank You ALL!” — Bob and Doris M., Sandy Oregon

” I write this review of Kitchen Concepts and owner/operator Dave Warren. I want to make mention that I was not asked or encouraged to write this review. I am a school counselor at the highest poverty, elementary school in Gresham. We are a very busy, high-needs school. I love my job but have been struggling organizationally with it as I have been working in a small room with piles of office supplies, therapeutic tools, paperwork, clothes, shoes and games stacked high.

It was a chaotic environment where I could never find anything when I needed it, and kids were always tripping over things. It was stressful and I often found myself dreaming about “if only I had shelves…..”

Then Kitchen Concepts came into my world. Dave heard my plea of desperation. He came out to my place of work and saw the need. He measured and designed a beautiful plan that included many shelves, drawers, two desks and all the storage I need to succeed. And the best news? He told me he wanted to donate all the materials and the labor. This undoubtedly would have costs thousands of dollars but he decided to donate as he saw the need of a local school. Dave told me that due to ongoing projects, he and his right-hand man John may not be able to complete all the finishes of this project due to time constrictions. I totally understood.

John and Dave (two of the kindest and most genuine guys you will ever meet) came down to install the shelves and literally didn’t take a single break. They worked like crazy for hours and did every every sort of finish and touch-up possible. The outcome was (and is) absolutely stunning. Immediately the quality of my work with kiddos has improved due to the beautiful welcoming space, the ability to find things when I need them and a calming feeling for students as opposed to a chaotic one.

I highly suggest this wonderful family-owned business to anyone and everyone out there. They care about our community, give to our kids, work hard, are generous, kind and create a beautiful product! Thank you from the bottom of my heart, Kitchen Concepts for being the incredible business that you are. You make a difference. – Jamie S. | School Counselor | Highland Elementary School | Gresham, Oregon  | June 2017

pages.text:
KELLOW CONSTRUCTION · DESIGN-BUILD · SANTA BARBARA, CA
Santa Barbara Home Remodeling and Renovation

Kellow Construction is a licensed general contractor in Santa Barbara, specializing in home renovation and the design-build process. As a design build firm, we’re a full service team for the entire project. We have architectural design, interior design Santa Barbara homeowners trust, planning, permitting, and construction. Our model has proven time and again that there is real power, efficiency, and a overall better client experience in having the designers and the builders all on the same team.

High-Touch, Small-Team Experience on Large Projects: Big enough and experienced to handle complex, high-end projects.

Small enough that homeowners still get senior attention.

Most of our clients come to us with a vision for their home remodeling project and the desire to have a different and better experience than the traditional design bid build model that they may have been frustrated with in the past. FAQs
What does “design build” mean?

The design + build model delivers a seamless, high-level process by bringing design and construction under one roof. Unlike the traditional architect bid model, where an architect designs and contractors compete to build, design + build fosters early collaboration, value engineering, and budget alignment. This ensures the design matches the budget and schedule, reducing costly surprises and delays.

With a single team handling every phase, communication stays sharp, efficiency stays high, and execution stays on point. Accountability is streamlined, meaning fewer gaps and more precision, quality, and care throughout the project.

While the majority of our clients have us fully manage the design and see the value of Design + Build, we also play well with others!  

Our Iterative Design Process (IDP), also integrate seamlessly with architects and interior designers, fostering a collaborative loop that refines ideas, maintains feasibility, and elevates the end product and client experience. We love partnering with design professionals who share our commitment to financial responsibility, quality and detail.

This approach reflects a commitment to doing things right, the first time. It’s an investment in a smoother, more refined experience, free from the friction of managing multiple parties. The result? A level of predictability that raises the industry’s bar.
